title: Seitokai ni mo Ana wa Aru!

thread.title: Even the Student Council Has Its Holes! • Seitokai ni mo Ana wa Aru! - Episode 5 discussion

opinions.point: Many viewers considered the episode one of the show's strongest and especially praised its comedic timing.
The animation was repeatedly praised as smooth, expressive, and visually polished, including the lighting and color design.
Character interactions and relationship development were widely viewed as charming and heartwarming.
The episode's fanservice was generally considered bold and entertaining, though some reactions focused heavily on it.
Viewers enjoyed the humor and character material but were divided on how excessive or distracting the fanservice felt.
A substantial group criticized the available English subtitles for mistranslations, missed jokes, and awkward wording.

title: Romelia Senki: Maou wo Taoshita nochi mo Jinrui Yabasou dakara Guntai Soshiki Shita

thread.title: Romelia War Chronicle • Romelia Senki - Episode 5 discussion

opinions.point: Many viewers praised the episode’s tactical focus and Romelia’s competence as a strategist.
Romelia’s vulnerability, compassion, and more human emotional side were widely appreciated.
Several commenters found the action intense and satisfying, with meaningful teamwork.
Some viewers enjoyed the battle outcome, while others felt the sudden magical breakthroughs were a convenient cliché.
A few commenters criticized the pacing, saying extended tactical explanations reduced the chase and battle’s momentum.
Some viewers noticed rough-looking movement and shortcuts in parts of the animation.
The soundtrack and musical presentation received repeated praise.
